newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end modestly higher, resist Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end modestly higher, resist Wall St.

text.p: Brazilian shares ended modestly higher Tuesday, resisting weakness on Wall Street, but brokers said the week's trend remains unclear in the absence of significant domestic news.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 52 most-active stocks rose 330 points to 64,158 points or a rise of 0.52 percent. Volume was a moderate 311.5 million reais ($305.8 million).

Analysts said today's performance does not indicate domestic share prices are now untied to movements on the U.S. markets. "The local market will continue eyeing activity on the foreign bourses, particularly Wall Street," one said.
Benchmark Telebras preferred closed up 0.83 percent at 78.50 reais.
Mining conglomerate Companhia Vale do Rio Doce preferred ended up 1.69 percent at 21 reais on optimism over the company's sell-off. Vale is scheduled to be privatized in the first quarter of 1997.
